WITH cur AS (SELECT sku, category AS cur_cat FROM dim_product WHERE is_current)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.cur_cat, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) web, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) training, sum(f.net_amount) allsales
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND c.cur_cat IN ('Garden','Electrical') AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH per AS (SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date AS d0, period_end_date AS d1 FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period = 8 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')),
cur AS (SELECT sku, category AS current_category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current),
u AS (
  SELECT per.fiscal_year, c.current_category, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku = p.sku JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT per.fiscal_year, c.current_category, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku = p.sku JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test')
SELECT current_category AS category, 8 AS fiscal_period,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN amt END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN amt END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
  round(100.0 * (sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN amt END) / sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN amt END) - 1), 2) AS growth_pct
FROM u WHERE current_category IN ('Garden','Electrical') GROUP BY current_category ORDER BY current_category
